review.summary: Single-hunk fix in the Expr conversion layer: when attaching a LineNumberNode to a function definition body, the old code pushed the location into any Expr's args, including bodies that were not blocks (e.g. an unwrapped/short-form body). The fix narrows the condition to `@isexpr(arg2, :block)`, so location info is only prepended to actual block bodies. This corrects malformed AST output rather than adding capability.
review.evidence: Minimized production patch touches only src/integration/expr.jl with 1 of 1 hunk kept, marked globally minimal and all hunks necessary. Accompanying test change in test/expr.jl. Runtime evidence reports a stable_differential across 3 repetitions with a dedicated trigger script, and the full suite passes on the fixed revision, which is consistent with a real defect that a test now pins down. The comment change ('Add location if not ErrorVal or unwrapped block') and the semantics of the guard indicate a wrong-output bug: a line node was being injected into an expression whose args are not statement lists, corrupting the resulting Expr.

review.validation_risks: Trigger identification relies on a dedicated script rather than a named test, so mapping the buggy revision to a concrete failing test case must be re-derived. The fix changes AST shape for a fairly common construct (function bodies), so the buggy revision may fail broadly rather than in one isolated test, which could complicate a clean single-trigger Defects4J-style bug. Also, ErrorVal handling is now implicitly covered by the :block check; if any legitimate non-block Expr body previously received a location node, some pre-existing expectations could shift.
review.suggested_tests: In test/expr.jl, parse short-form and unwrapped-body function definitions (e.g. `function f() end` variants, `f(x) = x`, and definitions whose body is a single non-block expression) and assert the exact resulting Expr, verifying no LineNumberNode is prepended into a non-block body's args. Add a case where the body parses to an ErrorVal to confirm no mutation occurs. Add a positive case with a multi-statement block body asserting the LineNumberNode is still prepended first.
